_comment_: Bootstrap template. Copy to /etc/river-vector/bootstrap.json and fill in. After first boot the device generates its own unit_id; leave it empty here. WiFi PSKs must be encrypted via scripts/install.sh (do not paste plaintext).
_compute_comment_: How this physical box fits the unit's compute layout. Default 'solo' = this one node runs everything; leave as-is for a single machine (a Chromebox, or a lone Pi 5). For a split Pi 5 + Pi 4 build: the control node uses topology=split, roles=[control], peers={vision: http://<pi4-lan-ip>:8090}; the vision node (Pi 4) uses topology=split, roles=[vision], peers={}. Provision via scripts/install.sh --topology / --role / --peer.
